reviewer: Claude Opus 5, WP3 route-authz lane (evidence run executed by the integration owner, automated session)
reviewedChange: Now accepts searchParams and proves membership of the requested Project before reading any task. Previously it called getActiveWorkspace, and no print route accepted searchParams at all, so whichever Project the cookie last pointed at was the one that printed; the accessor's third fallback could also print LEGACY_WORKSPACE_ID, a real workspace holding real tasks for which the caller had produced no membership proof (D-005). The first-run gate moved here from print/layout.tsx, which as a Next.js layout receives no searchParams and could therefore only ever gate the cookie's Project, never the requested one. Rendered output for an authorized Project is unchanged: same PrintTimeline, same data, same doc header. New rendered state: an unauthorized or unresolvable Project renders PrintRefusal instead of an empty board, so a blank artefact can no longer be mistaken for a real one. This surface has screenshotCoverage none and no approvedBaselineReference, so there is no baseline to recapture; the refusal state is uncaptured and that coverage gap is the finding. A print route is where a wrong-Project artefact leaves the building, which is why /print/timeline is reviewed rather than waived.
